title: L2P prompt pool with a shared-basis Mirror prompt generator
hypothesis: A per-prompt Givens coordinate over a shared 64D prompt basis will preserve retrieved prompt function quality while using <=60% of the actual explicit prompt-pool payload, with the same nearest-key retrieval rule.
physical_object: Eight learned soft-prompt vectors of length 64, each decoded by a fixed reshape into an 8x8 residual operator on frozen 8D features, and an eight-key nearest-neighbor retrieval pool.
mirror_coordinate: One SO(2) Givens angle per logical prompt, applied to a shared two-vector basis in prompt space; retrieval keys and retrieval rule stay identical across methods.
logical_multiplicity: Eight distinct retrieved logical prompts served by one physical 64x2 prompt basis and eight scalar Mirror coordinates.
prior_art_delta: PA56 L2P keeps a prompt pool and retrieves prompts from input features without task identity at test time. This screen preserves nearest-key retrieval and asks only whether the prompt-value bank can be reconstructed from a shared basis plus Mirror code.

model.decoder: reshape prompt vector to an 8x8 residual linear map; fixed no-parameter synthetic decoder
methods: explicit independent prompt pool + fixed nearest-key retrieval
hard-tied one prompt + fixed nearest-key retrieval
shared prompt vector + one scalar per key
shared 64x2 prompt basis + unrestricted two coefficients per prompt
shared 64x2 prompt basis + one Givens angle per prompt
model.training_schedule: Every bank method sees the same minibatch and all eight prompt-conditioned source targets at each update. Prompt values are trained with task identity during source-task experience; query-to-key retrieval is evaluated without task identity on held-out examples.

teacher.prompt_values: Flattened operators B0 @ R(theta_i) @ A0, where A0 and B0 are shared rank-2 factors and R(theta_i) is a per-prompt SO(2) rotation. This is a deliberately aligned prompt-value orbit.
teacher.keys: Eight orthonormal fixed prompt keys per world; query vectors are the true key plus Gaussian noise with standard deviation 0.35. The same keys, queries and retrieval algorithm are used for every method.
teacher.data: Gaussian frozen feature vectors; outputs are generated by applying the selected prompt's reshaped 8x8 operator.

controls: explicit full prompt pool, mandatory L2P storage/quality control
hard-tied prompt value with the same key pool
shared prompt vector plus scalar gates
shared prompt basis plus unrestricted two-value coefficients
shared prompt basis plus Givens Mirror angles
identical nearest-key retrieval and fixed prompt decoder for all methods

development.selection_metric: test output NRMSE after retrieved prompt selection; also report oracle-key prompt NRMSE, top-1 retrieval accuracy, actual prompt-payload bytes, retrieval MAC and selected prompt MAC
development.allowed_tuning: No tuning planned; one fixed configuration. If implementation is corrected, rerun development only before fresh access.

fresh.open_gate: Both development worlds: independent prompt source NRMSE <=0.03; independent and Mirror top-1 retrieval accuracy >=0.90; Mirror oracle and retrieved output NRMSE <= independent +0.02 and <=0.10; Mirror actual complete prompt/retrieval payload <=0.60x explicit pool; Mirror beats scalar output NRMSE by >=0.01 at <=1.10x scalar bytes; unrestricted coefficient control does not match within 0.005 NRMSE at <=Mirror bytes. Otherwise fresh remains sealed.

storage.authority: actual serialized compressed NPZ inference payload bytes after reload
paid_objects: explicit prompts or shared prompt basis
every per-prompt Mirror angle, scalar gate or generic coefficient
NPZ array names, headers and compression overhead

success_gate: All three fresh worlds pass retrieval, quality, <=60% total prompt payload, scalar and generic-coordinate controls; serialized prompt load/replay matches exactly.
failure_gate: Mirror misses the 60% payload or quality/retrieval gate, scalar control matches at comparable bytes, or generic coefficients match within 0.005 NRMSE at no more bytes.
boundaries: synthetic frozen-feature prompt pool; not a pretrained L2P reproduction or continual-learning benchmark
prompt values are deliberately generated on the same SO(2) orbit as the Mirror representation
retrieval keys and their bytes are charged and identical across methods
the reshape decoder has no learned weights; all prompt vectors are fully serialized
fixed updates and eight prompts do not establish natural-task capacity
